title: AI Won’t Make Our Minds Useless According to 400 Years of History
summary_html:
What if abundant intelligence makes human ambition expand rather than human relevance disappear? NLW explores Venkatesh Rao’s “Cognitive Mercantilism,” which uses the history of capitalism to challenge assumptions about AI and our intellectual future. From the agricultural revolution to today’s AI agents, the episode examines how cheaper intelligence could unlock new desires, new work, and possibilities we haven’t yet imagined.

Source: https://contraptions.venkateshrao.com/p/cognitive-mercantilism
